Clone an existing vault from a remote.

Cloning gets you the vault's files and history; it does NOT grant you access
to their contents. If this device isn't already a recipient, gage says so and
points at the command that generates a key to be added from a device that is.

Usage:
  gage clone [OPTIONS] <remote-url>

Arguments:
  <remote-url>  

Options:
      --device <NAME>  this device's name (default: normalized hostname)
      --dir <PATH>     target directory (default: $GAGE_DATA/vaults/<name>)
      --name <NAME>    local name for the vault (default: inferred from the remote URL)
  -h, --help           Print help
